source_text.body:
Run a personal assistant over an Obsidian vault
An OpenClaw agent connected to her Obsidian vault sends a daily agenda, checks progress, and creates or reschedules tasks and marks habits via Discord.
Done with
OC
OpenClaw
What they did
Antone Heyward runs an OpenClaw agent, Jenn, against his Obsidian vault. Tasks, calendar events and daily notes live in the vault or are reachable through the TasksNotes MCP. That makes the vault the single source of truth, with no direct Google Calendar access. Jenn sends a morning agenda, checks in on progress, and sends an evening wrap-up with a productivity score and reflection prompts. He messages her from Discord on his phone.
How it went
He says he's impressed. Jenn can create tasks, reschedule them, mark habits done and write drafts at any hour. He admits there are hiccups, but says it improves with use. The post gives no figures.
Worth knowing
The post is a short teaser. The setup details and demo are in the linked YouTube video.
Try it yourself
with
OpenClaw
Copy prompt
Connect to my Obsidian vault at [vault path] and my [Discord/chat app]. Every morning at [time], send me an agenda built from my tasks and notes, and check in on progress in the evening. When I message you, create or reschedule tasks and mark habits done in the vault; ask me before you delete or overwrite any note.
Original source: https://productivematters.substack.com/p/obsidian-openclaw-personal-assistant
